page_title: EMP 0-3 ACM | Empoli v AC Milan 07/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's all for today as the game is over.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' 0 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Chaka Traore (AC Milan) was set free in the area by Christian Pulisic and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
88' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
88' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.
87' Chaka Traore (AC Milan) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Federico La Penna saw the whole situation.
86' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Federico La Penna who sees an offensive foul.
85' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Rafael Leao and he is replaced by Chaka Traore (AC Milan).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Simon Kjaer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan).
81' Razvan Marin (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.
80' Dangerous play by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli). Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
78' The referee blows his whistle as Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) was too aggressive in his challenge.
74' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Razvan Marin (Empoli) replacing Alberto Grassi.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Daniel Maldini (Empoli) is replacing Francesco Caputo.
74' A lofted pass picks out Rafael Leao (AC Milan) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
73' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
71' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
71' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
70' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
70' A substitution has been made. Davide Calabria goes off and Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) comes on.
69' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.
69' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
68' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Federico La Penna signals a set piece. Empoli have a free kick from a promising distance.

67' Nightmare of a shot. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box but his shot goes high and wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
67' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
66' A cross into the box from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is cleared. The ball has crossed the sideline. Empoli are taking a throw-in.
64' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
63' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
63' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Yacine Adli (AC Milan).

62' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
59' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) tries to find Emmanuel Gyasi, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) comes onto the pitch for Tommaso Baldanzi.
57' The corner from Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is intercepted by Elia Caprile.
56' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
55' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Empoli will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' What was Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

52' Rafael Leao plays the ball through to Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
52' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.

51' Excellent touch by Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
49' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) passes the ball onto Tijjani Reijnders, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
47' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is behind the touchline and AC Milan will take a throw-in.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Yacine Adli (AC Milan) sends it out of play.
45' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' The resulting corner from Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is cleared by the defence.
44' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan). The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
43' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
43' Filippo Ranocchia (Empoli) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall. The linesman makes the right call and Empoli will have a corner.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Davide Calabria (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.

38' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
35' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is being substituted because of an injury. Stefano Pioli sends Alejandro Jimenez on the pitch.
34' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
31' 0 - 2 Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) brilliantly executes the penalty kick, sending the ball straight into the top left corner, bouncing in off the post. No chance for Elia Caprile to stop this shot.
31' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
30' It’s a PENALTY to AC Milan after the VAR review!
29' There's a break in play and referee Federico La Penna must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by AC Milan using VAR. This could be interesting!
29' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
29' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
28' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Filippo Ranocchia is coming onto the pitch as Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
28' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now AC Milan have a corner.
27' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
24' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

23' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires a low shot from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile is equal to it.
21' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and Federico La Penna blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
19' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' Tyronne Ebuehi (Empoli) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will take a throw-in.
14' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) takes the corner with a short pass.
14' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Empoli will take a corner kick.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Rafael Leao finds Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
11' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.

10' A cross by Davide Calabria (AC Milan) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is out of play. Empoli will have a throw-in.

7' Good play from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
7' Tommaso Baldanzi (Empoli) takes a short free kick.
6' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Empoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
5' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
4' Federico La Penna blows his whistle after Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

3' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
3' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. AC Milan have a corner.
1' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Empoli will kick-off.
Federico La Penna was nominated as the referee for this game.
